title: Flaky flow-slide-scroll-reaches-top spec: fixed sleeps race the hidden window's rAF
description: CI 38122461080 (3421921ca, MPI-1075) failed tests/desktop/flow-slide-scroll-reaches-top.spec.js 3/3 retries with noSlide, then passed on rerun. The spec sleeps 300/400 ms after each Next click, but data-active is set in a rAF, and the shell window can still be hidden (reveal waits on the landing's mascot clips) when shellWindow returns. Wait for the real condition instead.
